Hold + to go straight to Scan.
Each tile is a thing you can get here. Tap one to open it, hold it to collect.
Collect marks it as yours, today, where you are.
Cover gives directions to the manhole cover on the card.
Edit crops, turns or straightens this photo.
Each ring fills as you collect that set.
Hold My book in the bar to open Settings.
Plan a route, and Meguri tells you about stations on the way.
Tick what you already have; it goes into My book without a place.
Back up now saves a copy straight away. Weekly backup does it for you.
Each tip shows once more, the next time you open its page.
